features.body: The tree of might must be completely destroyed.
features.name: Deactivate

features.body: At the start of each round while the tree of might is intact, each enemy touching the ground in the encounter area who has M < 0 takes 10 corruption damage, and the tree of might grows a fruit. The [potency](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/potency) increases by 1 each subsequent round.
features.name: Tree's Nourishment

features.body: Once per round, any creature [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to the tree of might can take a fruit from the tree and eat it (no action required). The creature gains 10 [temporary Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/temporary-stamina) and has their Might score increased by 1 (to a maximum of 6) until the end of the encounter.
features.name: Mighty Fruit

flavor: A gnarled tree has unearthed roots that writhe and curl.
name: Tree of Might

stats.name: Immunity
stats.value: 5 to all damage except corruption or fire damage
